applicable_learner_decisions: Diagnose bronchiolitis from an infant's first wheezing illness after a viral prodrome while using age and the absence of focal or upper-airway findings to reject alternatives.

applicable_learner_decisions: Diagnose bronchiolitis from an infant's first wheezing illness after a viral prodrome while using age and the absence of focal or upper-airway findings to reject alternatives.

excluded_contexts: Do not use when the illness is a documented first wheezing episode under 12 months.

applicable_learner_decisions: Diagnose bronchiolitis from an infant's first wheezing illness after a viral prodrome while using age and the absence of focal or upper-airway findings to reject alternatives.
